comparisonGroups.purpose: Compare design, isolation, impedance and sensitivity while preserving sensitivity reference basis.

Separate amplifier output power at a stated headphone load, output impedance, connection types and whether a DAC is included. Existing FiiO K11 line-out source preset is not an existing headphone power-amplifier measurement.

Compare powered desktop and nearfield monitors by published response tolerance, package quantity, line/digital input roles and acoustic output test conditions; use independent measurements where available. Do not treat internal watts as acoustic headroom or mix peaks with continuous ratings.

required: headphone sensitivity value AND reference basis (dB SPL per mW or per V)
requested SPL and peak headroom (use conservative choices)
amp voltage and current limits or power vs rated load
matching physical connector and output topology
uncertainWithout: power rating at relevant load and stated distortion
max output voltage or load performance when interpolating
exact source signal level for stand-alone analogue amp
caveats: Do not compare dB/mW to dB/V numerically without conversion.
Power stated at 32 ohms cannot be used as guaranteed power at 300 ohms.
Output jack size is not a guarantee of balanced output; unsafe adapter wiring can damage equipment.
Some source devices already drive headphones adequately; do not prescribe an amplifier solely because headphone impedance exceeds an arbitrary threshold.
Headphone max power handling is not a recommended listening level.
